{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Borshavi''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. With a metropolitan-area population of approximately 4.29 million, it is the second-largest city in the country after [[Veshgadar]].

The city is home to the Borshavi National Park Stadium, a 65,400-seat venue used as one of the principal stadiums of the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]], where it staged the second semi-final between [[Easuhura]] and [[Verusa]] on 9 July 1760. A high-speed rail link between Borshavi and [[Veshgadar]], completed in February 1760, was built in part to support the city's tournament hosting role.
